🎥🎬: The Big Hit (1998)

Melvin Smiley is a skilled hitman with a kind heart who constantly finds himself manipulated by the people around him. When he and his partners kidnap the goddaughter of a powerful crime boss for ransom, the job quickly spirals out of control after the wrong people get involved.

As his fellow assassins turn against him and rival gangsters close in, Melvin must fight to protect the hostage, clear his name, and survive a series of explosive confrontations. Along the way, he discovers that loyalty is hard to find in the world of contract killers.

Starring Mark Wahlberg, The Big Hit blends action, comedy, and crime into a fast-paced adventure filled with shootouts, humor, and unexpected twists.

source_details.title: The Big Hit
source_details.synopsis: The Big Hit is a 1998 American action comedy film directed by Hong Kong filmmaker Che-Kirk Wong, and stars Mark Wahlberg, Lou Diamond Phillips, Christina Applegate, Bokeem Woodbine, Antonio Sabàto Jr., China Chow, Avery Brooks, Lainie Kazan, Elliott Gould, Sab Shimono and Lela Rochon. The Big Hit was released by Sony Pictures Releasing on April 24, 1998. The film received mixed reviews from critics and grossed $27 million against a $13 million budget. The film was shot in Hamilton and Pickering, Ontario, Canada.
